What we do

Roofing services for every stage of your roof's life

Your roof has different needs at different stages of its life. From a full restoration to a small leak fixed properly, here is how we keep Newcastle roofs in top condition.

Roof Restoration

Has your roof seen better days? A full restoration brings it back to life — we specialise in tile and metal roofing, so your roof looks great and lasts for years. A complete restoration can also improve your home's appearance and value.

  • Full clean and preparation of the roof surface
  • Cracked and broken tiles replaced
  • Re-bedding and re-pointing of ridge caps
  • Protective coating for a finish that lasts

Roof Repairs

Our repair specialists have seen everything from minor leaks to significant damage. Don't ignore the small issues — left unattended, they quickly become costly repairs.

  • Leak detection and lasting leak repairs
  • Broken, cracked and slipped tiles replaced
  • Storm and weather damage repairs
  • Rust treatment on metal roofing

Inspections & Maintenance

Not sure about the condition of your roof? A thorough inspection uncovers hidden issues before they become serious — regular maintenance is the key to a longer-lasting roof.

  • Full roof condition inspection
  • Honest report on what needs doing
  • Maintenance plans to extend roof life

Roof Painting

Sometimes all a roof needs is a fresh coat. Our roof painting service — including Colorbond roofs — gives your home a brand-new look and adds an extra layer of protection against the elements.

  • Fresh colour for a tired-looking roof
  • Added protection from sun and salt air
  • Suits tile, metal and Colorbond roofs

Metal Roofing

Looking for a durable roofing option? Metal roofing is an excellent choice for Newcastle homes. We install, repair and maintain metal roofs built to withstand harsh Australian weather.

  • New metal roof installation
  • Metal roof repairs and maintenance
  • Built for coastal conditions

How it works

From first look to final clean-up

No surprises and no pressure. You get a clear timeline before any work starts, and the job is done right the first time.

01

Inspect & quote

We inspect your roof, explain what we find honestly, and give you a free, clear quote.

02

Clean & prepare

The roof is cleaned and prepared so repairs and coatings bond properly and last.

03

Repair & re-bed

Broken tiles are replaced and ridge caps re-bedded and re-pointed to seal the roof.

04

Coat & finish

Primer and protective coatings or paint are applied for a finish that stands up to the weather.

05

Final check

We walk the finished roof with you, tidy the site, and make sure you're happy with the result.
